evidence: All 37 files of the frozen task were enumerated (no hidden, stray, .env, db, zip or symlink entries) and every file was pattern-scanned; small files were read whole. (1) Live credentials: none. task.toml:34-35 keeps the frozen template form `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`; the [verifier.env] block is identical to the template. A scan for provider key shapes (sk-, sk-or-, sk-ant, ghp_, github_pat_, AKIA, AIza, xox*, PEM blocks, JWTs, long Bearer values, Stripe pk_/sk_/whsec_, hf_) returned nothing, and the only 40+ character runs are comment rulers and CLI flags. The single password in the task is the documented demo password `Hireops!2026` (instruction.md:19, tests/app_context.md:8, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:25 and :361, solution/app/public/index.html:22 and :25, solution/app/src/db.js:126 with the comment `Public demo credential specified in instruction.md.`). The skill's known-false-positive list and the check 52 profile say demo passwords in the brief are intentional. Session tokens are generated at run time (solution/app/src/index.js:112 `crypto.randomBytes(24)`), not committed. (2) Seed data carries no credentials: environment/assets/seed_data.json users have only id/name/email/role/authority_tier, so the internal annotation `If task data itself contain credential flag it` is not triggered; solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to it. (3) Personal data: every email in the task is one of the seven `@hireops.example` demo accounts (reserved .example TLD) or `turing@local.invalid` (environment/Dockerfile:20, template text). Employees, users and candidates are plain invented names with no phone, address, date of birth, national id or other identifier; scans for SSN/phone shapes found nothing, and the only IP literals are 127.0.0.1 and 0.0.0.0. (4) Host paths: no drive letters, /Users, /home, workspace name, OS account name or author name anywhere; all paths are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests, /logs/verifier, /tmp/submission). (5) Remote fetch: the only URLs are localhost:3000, 127.0.0.1:3000 and the frozen `https://openrouter.ai/api`. No curl, wget, git clone, npx or runtime install in solve.sh, test.sh or the solution; solve.sh only copies files. index.html loads only same-origin /styles.css and /js/*.js, with no CDN. The golden's package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 exactly, and both Dockerfiles pin every npm and pip package to an exact version. (6) Injection payload: seed `note` fields are all empty strings and `generated_note` is a neutral description; no instruction-like text addressed to an agent or judge was found in seed data, the instructions folder or the solution's rendered strings; no zero-width, bidi-override or tag characters exist (non-ASCII is limited to U+2014, U+00B7, U+2026, U+00D7, U+2192, U+2212, U+00F7, U+03A3). All five judge prompts open with a line treating the submission as untrusted. The solution has no eval, new Function or child_process use. Residual observations, not defects for this row: (a) base images use floating tags without digests (`FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` in environment/Dockerfile:1 and tests/Dockerfile:1; `FROM python:3.12-slim` in tests/Dockerfile:2), apt packages are unversioned, and Chromium is fetched at image build by the pinned @playwright/mcp@0.0.79; these lines are identical to the frozen template, are template-controlled under the workspace rules, and the delivery profile declares public network and build-time fetching correct. (b) The golden stores the demo password in plain text and compares it directly (solution/app/src/db.js:139, solution/app/src/index.js:111); this is a reference-implementation hardening matter for a public demo credential, not a leaked secret. (c) tests/Dockerfile:28 and :41 set codex `danger-full-access` and patch rewardkit; identical to the template and outside this task's authoring. This row is a static check; no Docker run or portal checker (check-no-literal-secrets.py) was executed, and the result is a manual source review only. The raw evidence index contains no observation bearing on this row.
